curation.notes: Novel dual laser trap assay: two custom single-trap instruments each hold a bead decorated with native yeast kinetochore particles on the plus end of a surface-anchored, growing bovine-brain microtubule; computer feedback couples both through a virtual Hookean 'kinetochore' spring at constant total force, showing mechanical coordination of microtubule pair growth. Re-analysis of earlier single-trap force-clamp recordings (N=356) supplies force-dependent pause rates for modelling.
